cargo_items.name: Insulin (Regular/Rapid-acting)
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze. Discard after prolonged high-heat exposure. Protect from direct sunlight.

cargo_items.name: Insulin (NPH/Intermediate-acting)
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze. Gently agitate before use if cold-chain maintained.

cargo_items.name: Insulin Glargine (Long-acting)
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze.

cargo_items.name: MMR Vaccine (Measles-Mumps-Rubella)
cargo_items.precautions: Light-sensitive. Do not freeze diluent.

cargo_items.name: Influenza Vaccine
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze. Discard if frozen at any point.

cargo_items.name: Hepatitis B Vaccine
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze. Freezing causes irreversible potency loss.

cargo_items.name: COVID-19 mRNA Vaccine (post-thaw)
cargo_items.precautions: Extremely time-sensitive once thawed. Very narrow tolerance window.

cargo_items.name: Polio Vaccine (IPV)
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze.

cargo_items.name: Tetanus Toxoid Vaccine
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze. More heat-tolerant than live vaccines.

cargo_items.name: Whole Blood
cargo_items.precautions: Must remain in validated cold-chain packaging.

cargo_items.name: Packed Red Blood Cells (PRBCs)
cargo_items.precautions: Cumulative time above range affects shelf life.

cargo_items.name: Fresh Frozen Plasma (thawed)
cargo_items.precautions: Once thawed, use within fixed window, kept cold throughout.

cargo_items.name: Platelets
cargo_items.precautions: UNIQUE CASE: controlled room temperature, NOT refrigerated. Requires continuous gentle agitation.

cargo_items.name: Cryoprecipitate (thawed)
cargo_items.precautions: Short usable window after thawing.

cargo_items.name: Factor VIII Concentrate
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze.

cargo_items.name: Immunoglobulin (IVIG)
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze. Prolonged heat risks protein aggregation.

cargo_items.name: Etanercept (Biologic)
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze.

cargo_items.name: Adalimumab (Biologic)
cargo_items.precautions: Do not freeze. Protect from light.

cargo_items.name: Kidney (Deceased Donor)
cargo_items.precautions: Continuous static cold storage or machine perfusion required. Cold ischemia time is a hard absolute limit, independent of temperature control quality.

cargo_items.name: Liver (Deceased Donor)
cargo_items.precautions: Very narrow absolute viability window. Route delays directly threaten transplant viability.

cargo_items.name: Heart (Deceased Donor)
cargo_items.precautions: Shortest absolute transport window of all organs. Fastest viable route may be prioritized over coolest route.

cargo_items.name: Lung (Deceased Donor)
cargo_items.precautions: Extremely temperature and time sensitive.

cargo_items.name: Pancreas (Deceased Donor)
cargo_items.precautions: Continuous cold storage required throughout transit.

cargo_items.name: Cornea
cargo_items.precautions: Longest viability window of transplant tissues (up to 14 days), most forgiving of the organ category.
